snippet.title: ⭐ A Stray Line | Game Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
⭐ Wishlist A Stray Line on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4309480/A_Stray_Line/?beta=0
⭐ Join our discord server for updates: discord.gg/sprouthaven

"A STRAY LINE is a point and click Adventure Game with a spoonful of autumnal love and body horror. Explore a strange world, draw to cast spells, and discover what becomes of a lonely little family in the woods."

────── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ──────

⭐ FAQ:

Q: When will the full game release?
A: Chapter 1 of A Stray Line will come out sometime in the fourth quarter of 2026, as the free demo! It will have 2-3 hours of content, and release alongside a kickstarter to fund the full game (the rest of the chapters 2-5). From there, the full game will be updated for each chapter similar to games like Deltarune, to make it easier on my carpal tunnel :) 

Q: What systems will this run on?
A: Windows and hopefully Mac.

Q: Will the drawing system work with art tablets?
A: It seems to work with my Gaomon and Huion tablets. As long as it can register mouse clicks, it'll work fine.

Q: Is this story set in the GSGA universe?
A: Nope, it is a new universe/story with mostly new characters. You will see some familiar faces, but they are not connected to their GSGA versions!

────── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ──────

⭐ Original trailer OST ("Sunflower's Grave") composed by:
@ilyfar 
 https://open.spotify.com/artist/2HTnUHWHZ9c5rkpnM7DIJx?si=fATlFnNyTcSGU8L-j_1teA
https://www.instagram.com/__ilyfar/
────── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ──────

This has been an insane past year for me. Making a game was something my younger self only could have dreamed of, but now I know that if I want to do something, I should at least do it scared than to not do it at all. Thank you so much to my community for supporting me all these years, and giving me the courage to have a shot at my dream. I hope you enjoy A Stray Line, with chapter one coming later this year!

-Shilo
